nameEn: Manufacture of cordage, rope, twine and netting
description: This class includes the manufacture of cordage, rope, twine and netting from any textile material including jute, hemp, sisal, cotton and man-made fibres.
includes: manufacture of twine, cordage, rope and cables of textile fibres
manufacture of knotted netting of twine, cordage or rope
manufacture of other articles of cordage or rope
manufacture of plaits and similar products of plaiting materials
